name: Global Styling (Tailwind + Cyber Cockpit)
format:
<!-- Tailwind CDN & FontAwesome -->
<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css">

<style>
    @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Orbitron:wght@500;700;900&display=swap');

    /* ========================================================
       1. GLOBAL THEME DESIGN TOKENS
       ======================================================== */
    :root {
        --bg-top: #070c18;
        --bg-bottom: #03060c;
        --panel: rgba(13, 20, 36, 0.75);
        --tile: rgba(10, 16, 30, 0.80);
        --border: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.28);
        --border-glow: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.65);
        --accent: #06b6d4;
        --accent-soft: #38bdf8;
        --success: #10b981;
        --danger: #ef4444;
        --font-body: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif;
        --font-display: 'Orbitron', 'Inter', monospace;
    }

    /* ========================================================
       2. BACKGROUND & BASE TYPOGRAPHY
       ======================================================== */
    html,
    body {
        background-color: var(--bg-bottom) !important;
        background-image:
            radial-gradient(1000px 700px at 0% 0%, rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.14), transparent 60%),
            radial-gradient(900px 700px at 100% 100%, rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1), transparent 60%),
            linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-top), var(--bg-bottom)) !important;
        background-attachment: fixed !important;
        font-family: var(--font-body) !important;
        color: #e2e8f0 !important;
    }

    md-content,
    section,
    #Tab_Dashboard {
        background: transparent !important;
    }

    /* ========================================================
       3. PANELS & CARDS (GLASSMORPHISM)
       ======================================================== */
    ui-card-panel .nr-dashboard-cardpanel {
        background: var(--panel) !important;
        border-radius: 18px !important;
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--border), 0 20px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5) !important;
        backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(140%);
    }

    .nr-dashboard-cardtitle {
        font-family: var(--font-display) !important;
        letter-spacing: 2px;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--accent-soft) !important;
        font-size: 0.9rem !important;
        text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.35);
    }

    md-card.nr-dashboard-text,
    md-card.nr-dashboard-switch,
    md-card.nr-dashboard-gauge,
    md-card.nr-dashboard-chart,
    md-card.nr-dashboard-template,
    md-card.nr-dashboard-dropdown,
    md-card.nr-dashboard-text-input,
    md-card.nr-dashboard-button {
        background: var(--tile) !important;
        border-radius: 14px !important;
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--border), 0 10px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) !important;
        backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    }

    /* ========================================================
       4. FORM CONTROLS: DROPDOWNS & INPUTS
       ======================================================== */
    /* Labels */
    md-input-container label,
    .nr-dashboard-dropdown label {
        color: #94a3b8 !important;
        font-family: var(--font-display) !important;
        font-size: 0.75rem !important;
        letter-spacing: 1.5px;
        text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    /* Text Inputs */
    md-input-container input {
        color: #f8fafc !important;
        background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6) !important;
        border: 1px solid var(--border) !important;
        border-radius: 8px !important;
        padding: 6px 12px !important;
        font-family: var(--font-body) !important;
        transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }

    md-input-container input:focus {
        border-color: var(--accent) !important;
        box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--border-glow) !important;
    }

    /* Dropdown Select Boxes */
    md-select .md-select-value {
        background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6) !important;
        border: 1px solid var(--border) !important;
        border-radius: 8px !important;
        padding: 6px 12px !important;
        color: var(--accent-soft) !important;
        font-weight: 600 !important;
    }

    md-select:focus .md-select-value {
        border-color: var(--accent) !important;
        box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--border-glow) !important;
    }

   
        /* ========================================================
        5. BUTTONS (DARK GLASS + ORBITRON - ZERO GLOW)
        Matches the tile background, title sky-blue, and font
        ======================================================== */
        md-card.nr-dashboard-button button,
        md-card.nr-dashboard-button .md-button {
        background: rgba(10, 16, 30, 0.85) !important;
        background-color: rgba(10, 16, 30, 0.85) !important;
        border: 1px solid rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.35) !important;
        border-radius: 8px !important;
        color: #38bdf8 !important; /* Exact title sky-blue */
        font-family: var(--font-display) !important; /* Orbitron */
        font-size: 0.78rem !important;
        font-weight: 700 !important;
        letter-spacing: 2px !important;
        text-transform: uppercase !important;
        box-shadow: none !important; /* Glow removed */
        text-shadow: none !important;
        transition: background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease !important;
        }
        
        md-card.nr-dashboard-button button:hover,
        md-card.nr-dashboard-button .md-button:hover {
        background: rgba(20, 32, 60, 0.95) !important;
        background-color: rgba(20, 32, 60, 0.95) !important;
        border-color: #38bdf8 !important;
        color: #ffffff !important;
        box-shadow: none !important;
        transform: translateY(-1px) !important;
        }
        
        md-card.nr-dashboard-button button:active {
        background: rgba(10, 16, 30, 0.95) !important;
        transform: translateY(0) !important;
        box-shadow: none !important;
        }
        
        /* Start Button Accent (Dark Glass with Red Edge & Text) */
        md-card.nr-dashboard-button[node-id="ui_btn_start_rec"] button,
        md-card.nr-dashboard-button[node-id="ui_btn_start_rec"] .md-button {
        background: rgba(35, 12, 20, 0.85) !important;
        background-color: rgba(35, 12, 20, 0.85) !important;
        border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.6) !important;
        color: #fca5a5 !important;
        }
        md-card.nr-dashboard-button[node-id="ui_btn_start_rec"] button:hover {
        background: rgba(60, 18, 30, 0.95) !important;
        background-color: rgba(60, 18, 30, 0.95) !important;
        border-color: #ef4444 !important;
        color: #ffffff !important;
        }
        
        /* Stop Button Accent (Dark Glass with Slate Edge & Text) */
        md-card.nr-dashboard-button[node-id="ui_btn_stop_rec"] button,
        md-card.nr-dashboard-button[node-id="ui_btn_stop_rec"] .md-button {
        background: rgba(20, 26, 40, 0.85) !important;
        background-color: rgba(20, 26, 40, 0.85) !important;
        border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.4) !important;
        color: #94a3b8 !important;
        }
        md-card.nr-dashboard-button[node-id="ui_btn_stop_rec"] button:hover {
        background: rgba(30, 40, 60, 0.95) !important;
        background-color: rgba(30, 40, 60, 0.95) !important;
        border-color: #cbd5e1 !important;
        color: #ffffff !important;
        }
        
        /* Download Link Button (Dark Glass with Emerald Edge, No Glow) */
        .export-download-btn {
        display: inline-block;
        padding: 10px 20px;
        background: rgba(10, 16, 30, 0.85) !important;
        color: #34d399 !important;
        border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.6) !important;
        border-radius: 8px !important;
        font-family: var(--font-display), monospace !important;
        font-size: 0.8rem !important;
        font-weight: 700 !important;
        letter-spacing: 1.5px !important;
        text-transform: uppercase !important;
        text-decoration: none !important;
        box-shadow: none !important;
        transition: all 0.2s ease !important;
        }
        .export-download-btn:hover {
        background: rgba(6, 40, 28, 0.95) !important;
        border-color: #10b981 !important;
        color: #ffffff !important;
        }

    /* ========================================================
       6. ACTIVE SETUP HUD CARD (Clean Class)
       ======================================================== */
    .telemetry-hud-card {
        padding: 10px 16px;
        background: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.08);
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 10px;
        font-family: var(--font-display), monospace;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 10px;
    }

    .telemetry-hud-label {
        color: #94a3b8;
        font-size: 0.8rem;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 1px;
    }

    .telemetry-hud-driver {
        color: var(--accent-soft);
        font-weight: 700;
        text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4);
    }

    .telemetry-hud-vehicle {
        color: var(--success);
        font-weight: 700;
        text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4);
    }

    /* ========================================================
       7. TELEMETRY STATUS BANNERS & NOTIFICATIONS (CENTRALIZED)
       ======================================================== */
    .hud-banner {
        border-radius: 6px !important;
        padding: 10px 14px !important;
        display: flex !important;
        align-items: center !important;
        justify-content: space-between !important;
        font-family: var(--font-body), sans-serif !important;
        box-sizing: border-box !important;
    }
    .hud-banner-standby {
        background: #0f172a !important;
        border: 1px solid #334155 !important;
    }
    .hud-banner-rec {
        background: #1c1917 !important;
        border: 1px solid #dc2626 !important;
    }
    .hud-banner-alert {
        background: #1c1917 !important;
        border: 1px solid #78350f !important;
    }
    .hud-banner-success {
        background: #082f49 !important;
        border: 1px solid #0284c7 !important;
    }

    .hud-badge {
        font-size: 11px !important;
        font-weight: 700 !important;
        padding: 2px 7px !important;
        border-radius: 4px !important;
        letter-spacing: 0.5px !important;
        display: inline-block !important;
    }
    .hud-badge-standby {
        background: #1e293b !important;
        color: #94a3b8 !important;
        border: 1px solid #475569 !important;
    }
    .hud-badge-rec {
        background: #dc2626 !important;
        color: #ffffff !important;
    }
    .hud-badge-alert {
        background: #b45309 !important;
        color: #ffffff !important;
    }
    .hud-badge-registered {
        background: #0284c7 !important;
        color: #ffffff !important;
    }
    .hud-badge-completed {
        background: #059669 !important;
        color: #ffffff !important;
        font-size: 10px !important;
        padding: 2px 6px !important;
        border-radius: 3px !important;
    }

    /* Debrief Grid */
    .hud-debrief-card {
        background: #0f172a !important;
        border: 1px solid #334155 !important;
        border-radius: 6px !important;
        padding: 6px 12px !important;
        font-family: var(--font-body), sans-serif !important;
        box-sizing: border-box !important;
        overflow: hidden !important;
    }
    .hud-debrief-header {
        display: flex !important;
        justify-content: space-between !important;
        align-items: center !important;
        border-bottom: 1px solid #1e293b !important;
        padding-bottom: 4px !important;
        margin-bottom: 5px !important;
    }
    .hud-debrief-grid {
        display: grid !important;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr) !important;
        gap: 6px !important;
        text-align: center !important;
    }
    .hud-stat-box {
        background: #1e293b !important;
        border-radius: 4px !important;
        padding: 4px 2px !important;
    }
    .hud-stat-label {
        font-size: 9px !important;
        font-weight: 700 !important;
        color: #94a3b8 !important;
        letter-spacing: 0.5px !important;
    }
    .hud-stat-val {
        font-size: 13px !important;
        font-weight: 800 !important;
        font-family: Consolas, monospace !important;
    }

    /* Active Setup Readout */
    .hud-setup-readout {
        display: flex !important;
        align-items: center !important;
        justify-content: flex-end !important;
        gap: 8px !important;
        height: 100% !important;
        padding: 4px 10px !important;
        font-family: var(--font-display), monospace !important;
    }
    .hud-setup-label {
        color: #64748b !important;
        font-size: 0.72rem !important;
        letter-spacing: 1.5px !important;
        text-transform: uppercase !important;
    }
    .hud-setup-driver {
        color: var(--accent-soft) !important;
        font-weight: 700 !important;
        font-size: 0.82rem !important;
    }
    .hud-setup-separator {
        color: #475569 !important;
        font-size: 0.75rem !important;
        font-family: var(--font-body), sans-serif !important;
    }
    .hud-setup-vehicle {
        color: var(--success) !important;
        font-weight: 700 !important;
        font-size: 0.82rem !important;
    }


    /* ========================================================
       TOP TOOLBAR & APP HEADER (DARK CYBER COCKPIT)
       ======================================================== */
    md-toolbar,
    .md-toolbar-tools,
    md-toolbar.site-toolbar {
        background: #070c18 !important;
        background-color: #070c18 !important;
        border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.3) !important;
        color: #38bdf8 !important;
        font-family: var(--font-display), monospace !important;
        box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7) !important;
    }
    md-toolbar .md-toolbar-tools h2,
    md-toolbar .md-toolbar-tools span,
    md-toolbar.site-toolbar .site-title {
        font-family: var(--font-display), monospace !important;
        letter-spacing: 2px !important;
        color: #38bdf8 !important;
        font-weight: 700 !important;
        text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.4) !important;
    }
    md-toolbar button.md-icon-button md-icon {
        color: #38bdf8 !important;
    }


/* Hide obsolete empty template card for Add Vehicle in Setup group */
md-card[node-id="ui_v2_add_vehicle"],
md-card.nr-dashboard-template[node-id="ui_v2_add_vehicle"] {

}
/* ========================================================
       8. PILOT NAME & EMAIL INPUTS (MATCHES ADD CAR & CREW MASS)
       ======================================================== */
    /* Strip outer card container background, borders, and shadows ONLY.
       CRITICAL: Do NOT set height: 100% or display: flex on md-card,
       otherwise Masonry layout miscalculates card height and rejects row 1! */
    md-card[node-id="761e1b00612e55b7"],
    md-card[node-id="59482fb9f1c1a102"],

    /* Container padding & margins */

    md-card[node-id="59482fb9f1c1a102"] md-input-container {
        margin: 0 !important;

    }

    /* Remove Angular Material bottom underline spacer */
    md-card[node-id="761e1b00612e55b7"] .md-errors-spacer,
    md-card[node-id="59482fb9f1c1a102"] .md-errors-spacer {
        display: none !important;
        min-height: 0 !important;
        height: 0 !important;
    }

    /* Dark cyber cockpit input box - matches .fleet-select-input & crew mass inputs */
    md-card[node-id="761e1b00612e55b7"] input,
    md-card[node-id="59482fb9f1c1a102"] input,

    md-card[node-id="59482fb9f1c1a102"] .md-input {
        width: 100% !important;
        height: 34px !important;
        background: #070c18 !important;
        background-color: #070c18 !important;
        color: #f8fafc !important;
        border: 1px solid #334155 !important;
        border-radius: 6px !important;
        padding: 6px 12px !important;
        font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif !important;
        font-size: 11px !important;
        font-weight: 600 !important;
        box-sizing: border-box !important;
        outline: none !important;
        border-bottom: 1px solid #334155 !important;
        transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease !important;
    }

    /* Active / Focus Glow matching Add Car modal */
    md-card[node-id="761e1b00612e55b7"] input:focus,
    md-card[node-id="59482fb9f1c1a102"] input:focus,

        border: 1px solid #06b6d4 !important;
        border-color: #06b6d4 !important;
        box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.4) !important;
        color: #ffffff !important;
    }

    /* Subtle Placeholder Styling */
    md-card[node-id="761e1b00612e55b7"] input::placeholder,
    md-card[node-id="59482fb9f1c1a102"] input::placeholder {
        color: #64748b !important;
        font-size: 11px !important;
        font-weight: 500 !important;
        opacity: 0.85 !important;
    }

    /* Invalid email state indicator */
    md-card[node-id="59482fb9f1c1a102"] md-input-container.md-input-invalid input {
        border-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.7) !important;
    }
</style>
<script>
(function() {
    function setupPilotPlaceholders() {
        var nameInp = document.querySelector('md-card[node-id="761e1b00612e55b7"] input');
        var emailInp = document.querySelector('md-card[node-id="59482fb9f1c1a102"] input');
        if (nameInp && (!nameInp.getAttribute('placeholder') || nameInp.getAttribute('placeholder') !== 'Pilot Name')) {
            nameInp.setAttribute('placeholder', 'Pilot Name');
        }
        if (emailInp && (!emailInp.getAttribute('placeholder') || emailInp.getAttribute('placeholder') !== 'Pilot Email (alerts)')) {
            emailInp.setAttribute('placeholder', 'Pilot Email (alerts)');
        }
    }
    setupPilotPlaceholders();
    if (!window._pilotPlaceholderTimer) {
        window._pilotPlaceholderTimer = setInterval(setupPilotPlaceholders, 1000);
    }
})();
</script>

name: Accident Detection
Create All Tables
func:
let statements = [
    `PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;`,
    `PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL;`,
    `PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000;`,
    `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS drivers (name TEXT UNIQUE PRIMARY KEY, email TEXT);`,
    `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vehicles (name TEXT UNIQUE PRIMARY KEY, catalog_id INTEGER, weight_kg INTEGER, power_hp REAL, drivetrain TEXT, spec_summary TEXT);`,
    `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_catalog (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, make TEXT, model TEXT, serie TEXT, body_style TEXT, segment TEXT, year_start INTEGER, year_end INTEGER, production_years TEXT, cylinders TEXT, displacement_cc INTEGER, power_hp REAL, power_rpm TEXT, power_kw REAL, torque_nm REAL, torque_rpm TEXT, fuel_type TEXT, drivetrain TEXT, gearbox TEXT, top_speed_kmh REAL, accel_0_100_s REAL, weight_kg INTEGER, gross_weight_kg INTEGER, drag_cd REAL, tire_size TEXT, spec_summary TEXT);`,
    `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_catalog_lookup ON car_catalog (make, serie, year_start);`,
    `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, driver TEXT, vehicle TEXT, start_time DATETIME, end_time DATETIME, duration_sec INTEGER, top_speed REAL, peak_g REAL, points_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0, efficiency_score INTEGER, curb_weight_kg REAL, pilot_weight_kg REAL, passenger_weight_kg REAL, payload_kg REAL, gross_mass_kg REAL);`,
    `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS telemetry_points (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, session_id TEXT, timestamp DATETIME, speed REAL, temp REAL, hum REAL, lat REAL, lon REAL, accelX REAL, accelY REAL, accelZ REAL, gyroX REAL, gyroY REAL, gyroZ REAL);`,
    `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_telemetry_session ON telemetry_points (session_id);`,
    `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sessions_start ON sessions (start_time);`
];

return [statements.map(sql => ({ topic: sql }))];
